title: Technology Sector Update for 10/16/2018: MDB,PLUG,MRVL,LPSN
text:

Technology stocks led the U.S. markets higher for a second day in a row, with the shares of tech stocks in the S&P 500 Tuesday adding almost 3.0% in value today while the Philadelphia Semiconductor Index was rising nearly 3.2%.
Among technology stocks moving on news:
(+) MongoDB ( MDB ) rose as much as 8% on Tuesday after the database platform said it has created and has begun issuing a new software license continuing to allow public use of its open-source MongoDB Community Server but adding additional protections for its efforts developing the popular database. The company estimates it has spent about $300 million developing Community Server and said the new Server Side Public License will keep users from charging other organizations for any adaptations they make to the software. "With the added protection of the SSPL, we can continue to invest in R&D and further drive innovation and value for the (open source) community," CEO Dev Ittycheria said in prepared remarks.
In other sector news:
(+) Plug Power ( PLUG ) Tuesday sped to a more than 8% gain after the fuel cell technology company raised its FY18 revenue outlook to a new range of $175 million to $190 million, up from its prior forecast expecting between $155 million to $180 million in revenue during the 12 months ending Dec. 31 and exceeding the Capital IQ consensus by at least $900,000.
(+) Marvell Technology Group ( MRVL ) climbed almost 5% in recent Tuesday trading after authorizing an extra $700 million for its existing stock buyback program, increasing its overall repurchase capacity to around $1 billion.
(+) LivePerson ( LPSN ) was posting a nearly 4% gain on Tuesday, steadily building its advance this afternoon that followed the mobile and online texting company announcing its purchase of AdvantageTec, with plans to combine the specialty texting application with its Contact At Once! automotive unit, creating a platform for conversational sales activity across an entire car dealership. Financial details of the transaction were not disclosed.
